rule.message:
All students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements.
Collegiate Requirements:
All CLA BA degrees require 18 upper-division (3xxx-level or higher) credits outside the major designator. These credits must be taken in designators different from the major designator and cannot include courses that are cross-listed with the major designator. The major designator for the Mathematics BA is MATH.
Students are required to complete 4 semester(s) of any second language, with a grade of C-, or better, or S, or demonstrate proficiency in the language(s) as defined by the department or college.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) must complete the First-Year Experience course sequence.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) students earning a BA, BS, or BIS degree must complete CLA 3002 Career Kickstarter.
All students must complete a capstone in at least one CLA major. The requirements for double majors completing the capstone in a different CLA major will be clearly stated. Students must also complete all major requirements in both majors to allow the additional capstone to be waived. Students completing an additional degree must complete the Capstone in each degree area.
At least 13 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
STAT 5101 and STAT 5102 are the only courses from a different department that may count towards the Mathematics BA. The content of STAT 5101 is the same as MATH 5651, and only one of these courses may be taken, not both.
MATH 3283W, 4067W, 49xx, and 59xx MATH courses do not satisfy an upper-division mathematics major requirement.
Students may earn no more than one undergraduate degree in mathematics: a BA, a BS, or a minor.
In addition to the sub-plans described below, students who wish to pursue a pure mathematics track, or are planning to go to graduate school in mathematics should consult their advisor about appropriate course choices. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Actuarial Science, Computer Applications, Mathematics Education, Mathematics Biology: Genomics, Mathematical Biology: Physiology. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
